## Walkthrough

This PR removes a prerequisite dependency from the `test-e2e-extended-shard-0` make target in `Makefile-test.mk`. The target no longer requires `test-e2e-extended-shard-2` to complete before execution, allowing these e2e test shards to run independently.

## Changes

**E2E Shard Dependency Management**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Remove shard-2 prerequisite from shard-0** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`|`test-e2e-extended-shard-0` target dependency list is updated to remove `test-e2e-extended-shard-2` from its prerequisites, enabling independent shard execution while retaining `setup-e2e-env` and `kind-ray-project-mini-image-build` dependencies.|
